content: Added Windows Edition Conversion feature via SKUs: Easily convert to any Windows edition without reinstalling Windows.
Revamped the Office download and installation interface: Separated into a distinct tab with support for various Office versions.
Added applications to Downloads: Clipchamp, OpenShot, WPS, Polaris, Only Office.
Fixed an issue where the Enhance Privacy feature failed to open on some machines.
Fixed calendar opening bug when activating Optimize for Extreme Gaming: Using this feature will now automatically enable 'Disable Notification Center' on the Taskbar.
